title: vibe-release.json Release Document Spec
source: Non-Tech Change Management with AI Assistance Playbook
outputLocation: Project root, committed to the repo
structure: Flat, single-level object — every field is a top-level key; no nested objects.
fieldAudience: Every field serves our own governance record and the Vibe Code Project Registry. Keep them accurate — the registry and human reviewers rely on them — but never describe them as something the deployment platform enforces.
generateOn: Every check-golive-readiness run, regardless of verdict — the file records our governance verdict for the evaluated commit. That gate runs either directly via /vibe-check, or chained at the end of /vibe-review after an independent reviewer seals docs/REVIEW-PROOF.md (so the sealed review reaches this file without a separate /vibe-check re-run).
commitPolicy: Via /vibe-check the gate writes the file only and the user commits + pushes it (e.g. /push-github). Via /vibe-review, seal-review-proof commits it automatically as a second reviewer commit on top of the seal (so the reviewer's handoff is never left uncommitted); the reviewer only pushes. Either way the file sits one commit above target-commit-hash. Never hand-edit release-gate-status or target-commit-hash — re-run the gate instead.

releaseGateStatusValues.note: OUR governance verdict for the evaluated commit, for humans, reviewers, and the Vibe Code Project Registry. It is not a platform deployment gate. Treat a non-READY status as 'our own playbook says do not ship this yet', enforced by people and process, not by the platform.
releaseGateStatusValues.READY: Every applicable gate item passes and approvals are recorded — cleared to request deployment
releaseGateStatusValues.CONDITIONAL: Agent-checkable items pass but human approvals are pending — named approvers must sign off first
releaseGateStatusValues.NOT-READY: Blocking items open — do not request deployment

fields.review-gate: reviewGateByRisk[riskLevel] — records which review route our playbook requires for this tier
fields.review-verdict: The reviewer-sealed verdict from docs/REVIEW-PROOF.md / the latest PROJECT.md ## Review Evidence entry: PASS | FAIL | INCOMPLETE, else null when no proof exists. Refreshed on every gate run — including the run chained at the end of /vibe-review right after the proof is sealed
fields.review-proof: Path to the sealed proof — "docs/REVIEW-PROOF.md" when it exists, else null. A human-traceable pointer back to the full proof (reviewer identity, independence, checklist results live there)
fields.reviewed-at: ISO date the proof was sealed, else null
fields.release-gate-status: Our governance verdict for this run: READY | CONDITIONAL | NOT-READY (see releaseGateStatusValues — internal, not a platform gate)
fields.target-commit-hash: git rev-parse HEAD at gate time — the commit this gate record actually evaluated, so a later reader can tell whether the verdict still applies. It does NOT select what gets deployed
fields.generated-at: ISO date of the gate run — lets a reader judge whether this record is stale
fields.start-vibe: ISO date the vibe-coding of this project started, for measuring project-start → staging/production duration. Source: PROJECT.md ## Vibe Start when present (stamped by /start-vibe at project start, or by /adopt-vibe as the first git commit date for brownfield projects); fallback when the section is empty/absent: the earliest git commit's author date (git log --reverse --date=short --format=%ad | head -1). Effectively never null in a repo with history
fields.project-name: package.json name, else the repo directory name
fields.project-owner: PROJECT.md ## Project Owner — a single GitHub username (no leading @, no URL), verified to exist and to be a acme-org-ops member by the gate item ownership-support-contacts in golive-gate.json
fields.support-contact: PROJECT.md ## Support Contact — a single email address, lowercased; public webmail and shared lab/group accounts are rejected by the gate item ownership-support-contacts
fields.gcp-label-company: PROJECT.md ## Label → Company — one of gcp-label-set.labels.gcp-label-company.allowed in golive-gate.json; used for cost showback
fields.gcp-label-div: PROJECT.md ## Label → Division — one of gcp-label-set.labels.gcp-label-div.allowed in golive-gate.json (operations | finance | marketing | commercial)
fields.gcp-label-dept: PROJECT.md ## Label → Department — free-text owning department, else null
fields.app-web-url: URL from PROJECT.md ## Hosting Location if recorded, else null
fields.repo-url: git remote get-url origin — the APPLICATION repo
fields.live-version: Single string: root package.json version; monorepo with a private root → the highest version among apps/*/package.json (ops-github versioning-policy.json semantics)

registryNote: The flat project fields (project-name … live-version) are for the Vibe Code Project Registry and internal governance; any registry integration is separate from the deployment platform's CI/CD.
